acceptance_criteria.requirement: Authorized base commit and tree plus every Part 1 predecessor gate are independently verified.
Stage 0, Stage 1, and Stage 2 deterministic proofs remain unchanged and reproducible.
Python 3.11+, Java 17, PySpark 3.5.9, and Py4J 0.10.9.9 form a pinned compatible local matrix.
Malformed, ambiguous, or incompatible inputs fail closed before feature output is accepted.
Spark computes all five governed FeatureForge definitions with typed empty defaults.
Latest knowable revision selection applies knowledge time before business-time and window filtering.
Every committed golden frontier agrees exactly with an independent standard-library oracle.
Future knowledge and retracted state cannot leak into an earlier frontier.
Canonical output is invariant to source order, definition order, customer order, and shuffle configuration.
Open-lower and closed-upper windows, empty customers, exact boundaries, and no-success cases are deterministic.
Offline generations are immutable, manifest-bound, complete-marker guarded, and tamper evident.
Affected-scope planning is conservative across inserts, corrections, retractions, and event-time movement.
Canonical incremental output is byte-equivalent to canonical full-rebuild output.
Preserved values are re-enveloped with the target generation and target knowledge frontier.
Unsafe scope size or unverifiable predecessor state triggers full rebuild or rejection, never partial success.
Seeded balanced, skewed, and high-cardinality workloads are deterministic and cover distinct bounded sizes.
Evidence captures structural physical-plan, partition, row-count, and skew diagnostics without timing claims.
Work avoided is reported as bounded pair counts derived from manifests, not extrapolated production savings.
Interrupted, replayed, tampered, and corrupt-predecessor paths isolate failure and recover deterministically.
Spark and recovery proofs regenerate byte-for-byte and are digest bound.
Lint, strict typing, full tests, coverage, security-oriented validators, and contamination checks pass.
Exact-head CI and review gates pass, then merged main is independently reproduced and receipt bound.
